name: reversi-game
description: ブラウザだけで遊べるアクセシブルなリバーシゲーム

scripts.test:e2e:v2: npm run build:v2 && playwright test --config playwright.v2.config.js
scripts.benchmark:cpu:task13:pilot: npm run build --workspace @reversi/shared && node scripts/task13-cpu-benchmark.mjs --plan pilot --output /tmp/reversi-task13-pilot.json
scripts.benchmark:cpu:task13: npm run build --workspace @reversi/shared && node scripts/task13-cpu-benchmark.mjs --plan full
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check-release.mjs
scripts.dev:v2: npm run build --workspace @reversi/shared && npm run dev --workspace @reversi/frontend
scripts.lint:v2: npm run lint --workspace @reversi/shared && npm run lint --workspace @reversi/frontend
scripts.typecheck:v2: npm run typecheck --workspace @reversi/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @reversi/frontend
scripts.test:v2: npm run test --workspace @reversi/shared && npm run test --workspace @reversi/frontend
scripts.build:v2: npm run build --workspace @reversi/shared && npm run build --workspace @reversi/frontend
scripts.check:v2: npm run verify:egaroucid && npm run lint:v2 && npm run typecheck:v2 && npm run test:v2 && npm run build:v2
